articles.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.36: I Am the Gambling of the Deceitful
articles.summary: Chapter 10 of the Bhagavad Gita, 'Vibhuti Yoga,' details Krishna's divine glories. In response to Arjuna, Krishna describes the infinite manifestations through which the divine permeates existence. This chapter offers profound spiritual insight into the omnipresence of the Supreme Being, illustrating how divinity expresses itself across creation for spiritual understanding.

articles.title: Cyberpunk 2077: Chrome #3 Preview: Night City's Worst Recycling
articles.summary: Cyberpunk 2077: Chrome #3 is scheduled for release this Wednesday, expanding the popular video game universe into a comic series. The new issue features the menacing return of the notorious Scavengers, who harbour sinister plans for the survivors. Additionally, a mysterious killer is actively stalking the dystopian streets. Aspirants can anticipate more high-octane action and intrigue set within Night City's technological future.

articles.title: Mobix Labs to Acquire U.S. Rare Earth and Critical Minerals Company Powering Defense and National Security
articles.summary: Mobix Labs, Inc. plans an acquisition to strategically integrate into vital U.S. supply chains. This move aims to bolster critical infrastructure for defence, national security, and artificial intelligence. For SSB aspirants, this underscores the increasing importance of robust domestic technological capabilities and secure supply chains in safeguarding national interests and advancing military readiness through AI integration.

articles.title: 2026 NFL Schedule Release: Bears and Vikings are offenses to target for fantasy football playoffs
articles.summary: The 2026 NFL schedule has been officially released, setting the stage for the upcoming fantasy football season. The article highlights that significant financial opportunities for fantasy players are concentrated in Weeks 15-17. This early release enables participants to meticulously plan their strategies, focusing on critical late-season matchups to maximize their potential for success and gains in fantasy leagues.
